content: Severe episodes of hypoglycemia are linked to a higher likelihood of developing cognitive decline or dementia. Impaired cognitive function can increase the risk of severe hypoglycemia, potentially because individuals may have a diminished ability to recognize or respond to symptoms of low blood sugar. To address this, healthcare professionals might adjust glycemic targets or A1C goals to minimize the risk of hypoglycemia, especially in patients who already have cognitive impairments. For more comprehensive guidance on managing hypoglycemia in older adults with type 1 or type 2 diabetes, refer to Section 13, titled Older Adults.
